subject: Pre-hire screening & revocation controls - evidence package
messages:
From: Elizabeth Hart <ehart@audittide.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 evidence request - pre-hire screening & account revocation logs

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for agreeing to support our SOC 2 Type II walkthrough for Acme Financial Services. As part of our control testing for HR and logical access, we need the following artifacts covering the period Oct 1, 2025 - Sep 30, 2026:  

- Summary of pre-hire background checks (policy excerpt + proof of completed checks for hires)
- Training completion roster for annual security awareness (csv preferred; include course id and completion date)
- Evidence of contractor acknowledgement forms (signed PDFs) for any non-employee contributors
- Offboarding/revocation logs showing access removal timestamps and the responsible approver

Please provide items as redacted PDFs/CSV or a secure link; we do not need PII beyond hire month and role. Can you confirm delivery by EOD Friday (2026-10-15)? If any items will take longer, let us know what you can deliver now and what will follow.

Thanks,
Elizabeth Hart
Senior Auditor, Audittide
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Elizabeth Hart <ehart@audittide.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-13T10:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request - pre-hire screening & account revocation logs

Elizabeth —

Acknowledged. We’ll compile the package and prioritize:  

1) Background check summary (redacted)
2) Training roster CSV (2025–2026)
3) Contractor acknowledgements (signed)
4) Offboarding/revocation audit logs

Connor and Kim — can you own collecting the artifacts and producing redacted versions for external review? Please place final files in the secure drive link below and ping me once uploaded. I’ll perform a quick QA before we send to Audittide.

Drive upload: https://drive.restricted.redwood/secure/drive/ea7f2a9d
Deadline: EOD 2026-10-15 (Audittide requested)

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-14T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Collected artifacts for Audittide - initial upload

Rishi/Laura/Kim —

I pulled the requested artifacts and ran a redaction pass over PII fields. Summary of what I uploaded to the secure drive (see manifest attached as audit_manifest.txt):

- background_checks_redacted.pdf (contains hire month, role; names redacted)
- training_roster_2025-2026.csv (columns: hire_month, role, course_id, completion_date, status)
- offboarding_revocations_2025-2026.csv (timestamp, user_id_anonymized, resource, revocation_type, approver)

Notes/flags:
- Contractors: we have 12 contractor acknowledgements; 9 are signed and scanned (I exported signed PDFs), 3 are pending signatures for short-term contractors started in Sep 2026. Those 3 are in contractor_pending_list.csv.
- Background check originals are stored in HR vault; per policy we share redacted summaries for audits.

Attachment stubs: audit_manifest.txt (manifest + MD5 sums), training_roster_2025-2026.csv, background_checks_redacted.pdf, offboarding_revocations_2025-2026.csv

Connor O’Brien
Security Operations Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Elizabeth Hart <ehart@audittide.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Sue Shaw <sue.shaw@acmefinancial.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request - follow-up on contractor acknowledgements

Rishi/Team —

Thank you for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the initial package and have two follow-ups:  

1) We see contractor acknowledgements for 9 signed contractors; could you provide the signed PDFs for those 9 (redacted) and confirm the target date for the 3 pending signatures?
2) For offboarding logs, please include proof that access removal events have an approver mapped (we saw some revocation entries with null approver). If the approver is a system account, indicate the escalation path.

If you can get the signed contractor acknowledgements and a revised revocation CSV with approver column populated by EOD 10/15, that would close most items for our control test.

Best,
Elizabeth
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Elizabeth Hart <ehart@audittide.com>, Sue Shaw <sue.shaw@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-15T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request - pre-hire screening & revocation controls - final package

Elizabeth / Sue —

Attached is the final package addressing your follow-ups:  

- contractor_acknowledgements.zip (9 signed, redacted PDFs inside; 3 pending signatures: contractors A/B/C — HR outreach in progress)
- background_checks_redacted.pdf (final)
- training_roster_2025-2026.csv (final)
- offboarding_revocations_2025-2026.csv (revised: approver column populated; system account revocations flagged in notes)
- audit_manifest.txt (checksums + change log)

Where the data is sensitive we redacted identifiers; we included hire month, role, and completion dates per your guidance. HR confirmed the three pending contractor signatures will be collected by 2026-10-20 and we’ll provide signed PDFs or DocuSign receipts.

Files uploaded to secure drive: https://drive.restricted.redwood/secure/drive/ea7f2a9d
DocuSign Envelope ID (pending): 3A5B-9F22-DC8E
